# Matšoba Floral & Gifting

> Florist in Limpopo, South Africa, with three flower shops: Lebowakgomo, Burgersfort and Ga-Nkwana. Fresh, handcrafted bouquets, bridal flowers, sympathy arrangements and gift hampers. Orders and quotes are handled on WhatsApp at 071 329 1054 (+27 71 329 1054).

Also written as "Matsoba Floral" or "Matšoba Floral".

## Branches

- Lebowakgomo, Limpopo — Lebowakgomo-F, Lebowakgomo, 0737. Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=12033186792989066412
- Burgersfort, Limpopo — R37, Burgersfort, 1150. Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=-24.66725,30.320583
- Ga-Nkwana, Limpopo — D4190, Ga-Nkwana, Fetakgomo Tubatse (near Ga-Nchabeleng). Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=-24.420583,29.794

## Bouquets and prices (ZAR)

- 20 Mixed Roses & Gyps — R650. Seasonal roses in red, pink, orange and white with gypsophila.
- 20 Red Roses & Gyps — R850. Fresh red roses with gypsophila, hand-wrapped.
- Bridal Bouquet — R950. Hand-tied white roses and gypsophila with natural twine.
- Custom arrangements (any stem count, colours or occasion) are quoted on request.

## Occasions

Weddings and bridal bouquets, gifts and gift hampers, sympathy and funeral flowers, table centrepieces, everyday flowers.

## How to order

1. WhatsApp 071 329 1054: https://wa.me/27713291054
2. Tap "Order via WhatsApp" on a bouquet in the catalog.
3. Use the quote form on the home page. It opens WhatsApp with the request pre-filled.

For delivery, customers include their date and area in the WhatsApp request and the team confirms availability.
